title: The hardest battle you will ever fight isn't against the enemy without; it's against the stubbornness within. ⚔️💥
paragraphs: The hardest battle you will ever fight isn't against the enemy without; it's against the stubbornness within. ⚔️💥

We often hold onto our own plans, pain, and pride so tightly that our hands aren't open to receive what God has next. We fear that surrender means losing control. But in the Kingdom, surrender is the ultimate power move. It is the doorway to your true purpose.
Your destiny is waiting just on the other side of your "yes" to God. Stop fighting Him, and let Him fight through you. It’s time to break out of your own way.
📖 The Word: “See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.” — Isaiah 43:19 (NIV)
